title: Pan-Seared Lamb with Japanese Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and savory dish combining the richness of lamb with the bold flavors of Japanese stir fry.
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season lamb chops with salt and pepper.
Add 1 tbsp of vegetable oil to the skillet and sear lamb chops for 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove lamb from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable oil.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
Add sliced bamboo shoots, bell peppers, and snow peas to the skillet.
Pour in soy sauce and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Return lamb chops to the skillet and stir-fry for another minute.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve hot.
Let lamb rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
